name: Efficacious Channeling (General)
body:
Your channeled energy is stronger.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, channel energy class feature.

Benefit(s): All dice rolled to determine the effect or damage of a use of channeled energy receive a +1 bonus and all saving throw DC s to resist your channeled energy are increased by +1.
